title: Martingale Score: An Unsupervised Metric for Bayesian Rationality in LLM Reasoning
reasoning: The paper includes evaluations in 'value-laden' and 'subjective' domains such as r/ChangeMyView, where it specifically examines if LLMs can revise their opinions on value-oriented stances and controversial topics. This involves benchmarking moral judgment and values in the context of belief entrenchment.
